api.auth: OAuth2 password grant (POST /api/oauth2/token) with a portal service account

policyMapping.model: portal policy id -> backup job name (VMware backup job)
policyMapping.none: remove the VM from every mapped job (exclusion list)
policyMapping.preferredAlternative: keep vsphereTag: configure each job with the vSphere tag Backup-Policy/<id> as its only object, no connector needed

permissions: Veeam Backup Operator role is not enough to edit jobs; a custom role limited to the mapped jobs is required
notes: No secrets in this file. Template only - not loaded by the portal.
